text: Constant relationship and conjunction. The activity that is established by the presence of the metal (Ayuta) is such that, between the two, only one remains independent while the other is dependent; thus, in the case of the metal’s establishment, only one of the pair persists. The two components—organ and organ‑part—are multiplied in their qualities, possessing both action and reaction, and they are characterized as being of the same kind, expressed, distinguished, eternal, and material.
